## Rule

Triangle fill (Pattern Recognition | Filling Regions). Input: a single red (color-2)
horizontal run of length L starting at **column 0** of some row R; everything else bg.
Output: row r gets `width(r) = L + R - r` cells from col 0 — color **3 above** row R,
**2 at** R (the original line, unchanged), **1 below**; bg elsewhere in the H×W grid.

**Generator bounds — verified on ALL 200k corpus pairs (2026-06-06)**: input colors only
{0,2}; exactly one row holds 2s, contiguous from col 0; L∈[2,8]; R∈[1,7] (never edge rows);
H,W∈[4,13]; S=L+R≤9 with **S≤H−1** (triangle never spills past the grid bottom) and
**width never exceeds W** (no right clip). These bounds carry the v2 design (same confidence
class as the 13×13 crop contract — LIVE itself crops to 13×13).

## u8-COMPARE class (v8/v9) — how the F16-Add floor was halved again

The owner's sub-1500 push broke the "F16 is the smallest float" frame: a COMPARISON final
(`Less`) takes **u8 operands (1 byte) and emits BOOL** — identical rank-1 coupling power
(`a<b ⟺ a−b<0`) at half the operand bytes. Pads drop 600+600 → 300+300. Construction:

```
out = Less(C [1,10,1,30] u8 codes, T [1,10,30,1] u8 thresholds)   # fire ⟺ C < T
bands: C = w (ONE shared static arange init, 0 bytes); fire ⟺ w < T(c,r)
  T1 = sat(Min(S−r, 32(r−R)))      T3 = sat(Min(S−r, 32(R−r)))
  T2 = sat(Min(S−r, 32−32|r−R|))   # red row: gate 32 > max(S−r)=9 only at r=R
  T0 = sat(Min(13−(S−r), 32(H−r)−6))            # bg, vs descending code
ch0: C0 = sat(Max([12..0 | 31×17], 32(w−W)+26))  # w-cliff at W in one Max
sat = QuantizeLinear(·, scale=1) at opset 19 (v9) — SATURATING F16→u8 cast
      (v8 @opset12 uses Relu+Cast instead: +4 clamps, cost 1,679)
```

**U8-WRAP ASYMMETRY LEMMA** (the design's load-bearing safety fact, probed): plain Cast
F16→u8 wraps mod 256. Wrapped negatives on the CODE side become huge codes = never-fire =
SAFE; on the THRESHOLD side they become fire-all = CATASTROPHIC. v8: Relu before every
T-cast + C-side residue proof (cliff slope 32 | 256 ⇒ residues of 26+32j ≥ 26 > maxT0=22).
v9: QL saturation makes both moot. Integer-native design throughout (strict `<` needs no
half-offsets); all F16 intermediates ≤ 858 (exact).

## Cost-floor verdict across ALL classes (2026-06-06, post-owner-push; updated after C13)

- **u8-compare class FORCED-COMPONENT floor (re-derived 2026-06-20, worker-256-1 BEAT-OR-WALL)**:
  the old "≈1,239" line was a LOOSE optimistic estimate (combo head guessed 160 vs actual
  120+56-scalar-chain; bases/clamps guessed 234 vs actual 286 incl. the 2 C-side F16 ops).
  Summing every FORCED tensor from the real v13 graph reconciles EXACTLY to 1,231 mem + 97 p
  = **1,328**. There is NO 89-byte gap to close — 1,239 was never achievable. Ledger:
  | bytes | tensor | why forced |
  |---|---|---|
  | 300 | T `[1,10,30,1]` u8 | output is `[1,10,30,30]`; broadcasting binary final needs a `[1,10,30,1]` operand; u8 = min dtype feeding `Less`; ch-dim can't drop below 10 |
  | 300 | C `[1,10,1,30]` u8 | the other broadcast operand; ch-dim forced 10 (bg code ≠ band code ⇒ not channel-1-broadcastable, same proof as the Add class) |
  | 120 | combo `[1,30]` F32 | F32 `input` ⇒ Einsum emits F32 (casting input to F16 = 3,380 B; cropping h to 13 = 7,800 B Slice); ArgMax/Max/Sum all need the full per-row vector |
  | 52+52 | T4 `[1,4,13,1]` + C4 `[1,4,1,13]` u8 | 4 distinct color-threshold channels (bg/below/red/above = the rule's 4 output colors) + 2 distinct code profiles, pre-pad |
  | 286 | 11× `[1,1,13,·]` F16 @26 | 5 bases (smr,d32,negd32,t0b,hcliff) + 4 clamps (m0,m1,m3,sum2) + 2 C-side (cliffline,c0); fan-out audit shows MAX reuse already (smr→3 consumers; m1,m3→both sum2 and a QL = the T2 fold; L_c→S_c and sum2) |
  | 65 | 5× QL u8 @13 | T0-T3 + C0 saturating casts; each clamp's raw value exceeds 255 (e.g. hcliff up to 416) so the Min must precede the QL — saturation cannot replace any clamp |
  | 56 | head scalar chain | R_i 8 + 8×F32 @4 + 8×F16 @2 |
  Six prior hostile sweeps + this one found no further fold. The last three improving finds
  were T2-from-band-mins (−52), the C13 pad-fill (−203), and floor-L from the combo maximum
  (−6); this wave (U8CompareGapBeatOrWall) found NONE. **v13 = 1,328 is the PROVEN
  forced-component floor of the u8-compare class.**
- **Under-1,500: ACHIEVED at both risk tiers** (v11 1,476 @opset12-MED; v12 1,334
  @opset19-HIGH).
- **Under-900 verdict: IMPOSSIBLE in every enumerated class.** Any broadcasting binary final
  needs per-channel r-side AND w-side operands ≥ 10×30 elements each ⇒ ≥ 600B at u8 (BOOL
  operands cannot feed comparisons; And/Or finals = rectangle regions only — proven). Add
  the irreducible head (one [1,30] F32 reduction = 120 + scalars) and ANY threshold
  construction (≥ 4 row-profiles + 1 w-profile + gates ≈ 250+) ⇒ > 900 strictly. A sub-900
  would require the grader to misprice statics — which §39 MECHANISM (grader-source-read)
  rules out.
- Caveat per the day's thrice-burned lesson: this verdict is enumeration-relative. The
  enumeration now covers: Add/Sub/Mul/Min/Max/Where/Less/Greater/Equal-final,
  Pad/Resize/Expand/Tile/DepthToSpace-final, MatMul(+Integer)/Conv(Transpose)-final,
  Gather*/Scatter*/OneHot/Concat-final, unary finals, input-as-operand tricks (Sum 3-op:
  priced, no win — v7's encoding never paid for what `input` provides), and
  initializer-operand finals (ch0's W-cliff is data-dependent ⇒ B/C must be computed).

## Don't-do log

- **Confirming grid_mask safety**: The Min(inp_relu, one_broad) pattern is safe to remove only because inp_relu is Relu of a ReduceSum over a 0/1 input (one-hot channel encoding). Verify this assumption before applying elsewhere.
- **Self-test encoder trap (cost a debug round, 2026-06-06)**: when hand-rolling a test
  harness, padding cells OUTSIDE the active grid must be ALL-channel-zero on BOTH the input
  encoding AND the expected-output one-hot (core.md padding rule). `np.eye(10)[idx]` alone
  marks outside cells ch0=1 → 0/266 false alarm while the model is actually perfect. Use
  `ng_gate` (official encode) as the gate; self-tests must mask `[:H,:W]`.
- **Bool-output status (UPDATED by the 2026-06-06 owner push)**: the original "don't
  bool-reformulate" stance was for an unsanctioned −13-LB-class gamble worth +0.35 pts. The
  owner explicitly sanctioned the probe; v8/v9 (BOOL-output u8-compare) are staged as
  EXPERIMENT tiers with the risk documented in their manifests. Do NOT promote v8/v9 to
  safe-primary status until a real submit confirms the class; v7 remains the safe primary.
  If v8/v9 regress on Kaggle despite ab-0-divergence, record it as grader/runtime behavior
  (sharper than the task080 datapoint) and keep shipping v7.
- **Don't reach for GridSample/CumSum/flood here**: the fill is closed-form rank-1
  (width = L+R−r), not a propagation — no iteration needed at all (#47 K≥12 rule moot).
- **Levers measured-and-rejected by the 2026-06-20 BEAT-OR-WALL audit (worker-256-1)** — do
  NOT re-chase: (a) **F16 combo head** (−60 B): head arithmetic IS F16-exact across all 1,585
  generator params (verified: Max=W+64L≤525, Sum=HW+64L≤681, all Div resolve exactly), BUT
  combo inherits F32 from the F32 `input` Einsum — making it F16 needs an input cast (3,380 B)
  ⇒ net loss. (b) **combo→[1,13]** (−54 B): would need a `[1,10,13,30]` F32 input Slice
  = 7,800 B ⇒ huge loss. (c) **shared-channel C operand** (drop C to `[1,1,1,30]`): IMPOSSIBLE
  — bg ch0 needs an INTERVAL `[width,W)` = descending code + w-cliff, distinct from the bands'
  ascending `w<width` code; C carries ≥2 distinct channel profiles (same proof as the Add
  class, archive line 73). (d) **absorb a Min-clamp into QL saturation** (§72): every raw
  clamp input exceeds 255 (hcliff≤416) so the Min must precede the QL; saturation only kills
  the negatives, not the upper cap. (e) **eliminate negd32 / fold a base tensor**: fan-out
  audit shows every `[1,1,13,·]` tensor has a distinct necessary role and maximal reuse — no
  redundant op output exists. Verdict: 1,328 is the forced floor; v13 holds.
- **U8 13×13 color-index canvas + Equal-tail (the #8b/#67/#81/#142 lever) — MEASURED LOSS,
  do NOT re-chase (worker w12, 2026-06-21, beta_p15).** The proposal was: replace the two
  broadcast operands T+C (300+300=600 B) with a single `[1,1,13,13]` U8 color-index canvas
  (169 B) computed from L,R,S, then `Equal(Pad(canvas→30×30), ch_ids[1,10,1,1]) == output`,
  with claimed total ~350-400 B. **The premise is FALSE: to lift a single-channel canvas to
  the required `[1,10,30,30]` output you MUST materialize a CHARGED full-size intermediate
  before the channel-expand:** (A) Pad-then-Equal charges the `[1,1,30,30]` U8 Pad output =
  **900 B** (measured: tail-only `score_v2 = (0, 900, 187)`); (B) Equal-then-Pad charges the
  `[1,10,13,13]` BOOL Equal output = **1,690 B**. Both >> the current 600 B operands. The
  broadcast-binary `Less(C[1,10,1,30], T[1,10,30,1])` wins precisely because the
  `[1,10,30,30]` explosion exists ONLY as the FREE named `output` (the broadcast happens AT
  the free node); the canvas family forces a charged 30×30 (or 10×13×13) tensor one op
  before the free output. §81's "Equal-tail canvas is FIXED ~900 B" law applies — the 169 B
  figure ignored the mandatory Pad-to-30×30 intermediate. §142 (mask×single-color-vector)
  also does not apply: the wedge has THREE color regions (3 above / 2 at / 1 below R), not
  one. The Trilu-shaped-wedge alternative shares the same channel-expansion tax. The
  broadcast-binary class (1,328) remains strictly cheaper than the canvas/Equal-tail class.
